chapter_note: Classic substrate teaching: zoomorphic mapping of the archon's body parts to the five worlds of Darkness (lion-head/fire, eagle-wings/wind, demon-feet/smoke, fish-belly/water, dark-loins/darkness), followed by triadic attributes (beasts/myriads/firm-body, then fire/cold/searching-knowledge). Heavily damaged (82.8%) but the cosmological architecture is unmistakable. Apostolic dialogue frame at i=3-4 introduces the teaching. Editorial fatigue strong: hortatory pivot at i=51-63 caps the chapter with pastoral exhortation about avoiding the archons' "loves" and "bitter teachings" and clinging to the "Mind of truth." Editor's frame is thin and isolatable; substrate dominates.
